verdict.rationale: Flagsmith documents an MCP server that lets AI agents call its Admin API, and a 'Release Pipeline' automation feature marketed as an 'intelligent release assistant,' but neither is evidence of the product itself generating AI-derived insights or suggestions from flag/experiment data (e.g., anomaly detection, recommended rollout percentages, natural-language summaries of experiment results). No such AI-analytics capability is documented anywhere in the evidence pack.
